title: Chapter 18 The City Is Open, Enter The City
content:
Chapter 18 The City Is Open, Enter The City

Outside the deserted city.

Within a month, tall buildings have been built one after another, with attics everywhere, and people are bustling inside, which is very spectacular.

And a month ago, this place was still a wild land.

All this is because of a hazy giant city in the center of the new city.

In a month, with the help of the Ji family of the Tianxuan world, including the Tianxian Sect, the Moon God Sect, and the Zhan Sect, the expansion of the city was perfectly completed.

Next, it is time to wait for the opening of this mysterious giant city.

As for how long it will take, it is unknown.

In one of the tallest buildings, several powerful men with deep auras sat together, seemingly discussing something.

"This giant city has attracted their attention."

A middle-aged man said slowly.

"Yes, such a big movement is not only noticed by us."

"Let me make it clear first, my Ji family is not interested in the resources in this giant city. It is enough for us to make money outside the giant city."

Hearing this, a woman sneered: "Not interested? I think you dare not compete with those beings."

These people are the four major forces that jointly created the expansion of the city.

Hearing this, Ji Wuhui did not speak.

Although their major forces appear to be majestic in the Tianxuan world, including this expansion of the city, no other forces dare to interfere with them, but they know that it is because stronger beings do not value this little benefit.

What they really value is this mysterious giant city.

Once the giant city is opened, those guys will surely show their edge.

At that time, there will be no place for them.

And at this moment, a buzzing sound suddenly sounded.

Instantly, the faces of several people changed drastically, and the next moment they appeared in the void.

In the center of the new city, the mysterious giant city was shaking slightly.

Seeing this scene, several people looked at each other.

"The city is about to open!"

There was a loud bang.

The next moment, the hazy giant city gradually became clear.

The barrier gradually dissipated, and a giant city full of supreme aura appeared in everyone's sight. Just looking at it, everyone felt dizzy.

"The city is open, open! Everyone rush!!"

I don't know who shouted, and the next moment, countless people rushed towards the direction of the giant city.

At this moment, facing the surging crowd, no one dared to stand up to stop it.

Because it would incur public anger, I'm afraid that if you stand up to stop it, you will be attacked by everyone.

In the void, Ji Wuhui and others nodded, and then rushed over.

Just now, I said no, but when it really came, my body was still very honest.

Don't want it in vain.

Several powerful practitioners rushed to the front, trying to fly directly into the giant city, but they fell to the ground with a bang.

An invisible force enveloped the giant city.

Unable to fly.

Seeing this, everyone had to run towards the city gate.

And this giant city actually only had one entrance open.

In front of the city gate, everyone stopped.

At the huge city gate, two young men in simple clothes were standing here, looking at everyone with a smile.

These are the two children of the old Zhang family in the city.

And now, they have all grown up.

"Who are you?"

One person in the crowd asked in confusion.

At this moment, everyone looked at the two in confusion, and no one dared to act rashly.

For this mysterious giant city, they must be cautious.

But facing such a giant city, they had to enter, there was no way, the temptation was too great.

"Well, we are sent by the great city lord of the deserted city to collect the city fee. If you want to enter the city, you have to pay first."

"Charge?"

Everyone looked shocked.

"Hmph, I won't give it to you, do you dare to stop me?"

Hearing the charge, a middle-aged man with a strong aura stood up and looked at the two angrily.

He turned out to be a strong man in the Divine Mansion Realm.

Seeing this scene, everyone was extremely excited.

They couldn't be happier that someone had stepped forward.

Just to see if these two young men have the strength to charge.

Just as everyone was ready to watch the show, one of the people at the city gate sneered: "It seems that you don't know what this is."

The next moment, under the horrified eyes of everyone, the middle-aged man was slapped and flew out.

He didn't kill him, but blood was still flowing, which made everyone terrified.

That was a strong man in the Divine Mansion Realm.

Could this young man be a powerful person in the Life Combination Realm.

In the distant void, Ji Wuhui and others saw this scene, and their eyelids twitched wildly.

This huge city is really not simple, just a gatekeeper is so awesome.

They could tell at a glance that the young man's strength was definitely more than just the Life-Combination Realm.

Could it be that he was already a half-step saint? !

At this moment, an extremely powerful aura suddenly attacked from a distance.

Everyone was shocked and immediately made way for him.

An old man in a Taoist robe was seen walking slowly from a distance, and behind him, a middle-aged man bowed his head slightly and followed him respectfully.

Seeing this old man, everyone looked puzzled.

Who is this awesome person?

In the void, Ji Wuhui and the others looked at the old man with strong fear in their eyes. These guys really appeared.

The hidden family of Tianxuan World, the Nangong family.

A powerful family, whose strength and foundation are not comparable to their Ji family.

Because this family has been passed down for endless years.

There was even an emperor among them.

At this time, the old man had already walked to the city gate.

After looking at the two people at the city gate, the old man frowned, and the next moment, the old man looked up at the plaque on the city gate, on which were written the two big characters "Desolate City".

Buzz——

In an instant, the old man seemed to be in an endless abyss. The supreme pressure emanating from the two big characters made him breathless, and waves of fear from the depths of his heart kept washing over his consciousness.

With just one glance, the old man collapsed on the ground with his eyes blank, and sweat continued to flow all over his body.

"Grandpa! You, what's wrong with you?"

The middle-aged man saw the old man in such a state, and immediately said anxiously.

The people around, seeing this scene, some people snickered.

"I thought a powerful person came, haha,"

"Oh, is this old man here to make fun of me?"

Hearing the words of the people around him, a fierce anger surged from the middle-aged man's body.

"Do you want to die?!"

Boom!

The breath of a half-step saint overflowed from the middle-aged man's body.

In just a moment, all the people around were frightened by this terrifying pressure and sat on the ground.

"Ayu."

At this time, the old man recovered and spoke.

Hearing the old man's call, the middle-aged man quickly put away his pressure and looked at the old man with concern.

"Grandpa, are you okay?"

The old man wiped the blood and tears from his eyes and said fearfully: "This city is extraordinary."

Hearing this, the middle-aged man was silent.

Seeing the appearance of his grandfather, he already knew.

Because his grandfather is a real saint.

He belongs to a living legend, and such a strong man faces a huge city, and he has already been like this before he even enters.

It is conceivable what the huge city looks like.

"My friend, how much does it cost to enter the city?"

Feeling the horror of the huge city, the old man looked directly at the two people guarding the city and asked.

Hearing this, one of them smiled and said, "Not much, not much, you only need to pay one million spirit stones to enter the city."

One million spirit stones.

Hearing this, the faces of the people behind him were shocked and angry.

Why don't you go and rob!

It takes one million spirit stones to enter the city. After this wave of operations, almost 90% of people can be swept away, and those who can take it out are either rich or powerful.

"Okay, I'll pay."

The old man just nodded indifferently when he heard this. In fact, he still felt that one million spirit stones were a bit too little.

Not to mention one million spirit stones, even if he emptied the entire Nangong family, he would be willing.

Because he clearly felt that there was an opportunity to become an emperor.

This value is immeasurable.

"Ayu."

The next moment, the middle-aged man next to the old man handed over a storage ring.

Inside, there were two million spirit stones.

"Well, go in."

Putting away the storage ring, the city guard nodded.

Then the two people from the Nangong family went in directly.

In this way, the first group of people to enter the deserted city was born.

Behind them, everyone looked at each other.

One million, most of them couldn't afford it.

It's really a penny that makes a man difficult.
